findings.evidence: Line 408 states `Matrix.trace ((torusExp θ : SU2) : Matrix ...) = 2 * ...`; `coe_torusExp` at line 397 is the actual coercion-evaluation lemma, while repository search finds no other `trace_coe_*` precedent.
findings.fix: Rename it to `trace_torusExp` and update all references.
findings.issue: `trace_coe_torusExp` misleadingly advertises a coercion lemma, but its conclusion evaluates the trace of `torusExp`; the adjacent analogous theorem is `trace_torusMatrix`.

findings.evidence: Line 127 states `IsConj (torusExp θ) (torusExp φ) ↔ Real.cos φ = Real.cos θ`; the adjacent line-114 theorem follows the descriptive pattern `isConj_torusExp_iff_trace_eq`.
findings.fix: Rename it to `isConj_torusExp_iff_cos_eq` and update references.
findings.issue: `isConj_torusExp_iff` omits the right-hand characterization, so it does not describe the conclusion `Real.cos φ = Real.cos θ`; the naming guide requires descriptive theorem names and uses `_iff` with the right side identified.

summary: Two introduced names do not accurately describe their conclusions in standard Mathlib terminology.
